interpretation_boundary: Names propose typed operations. Classical facts, exact external evidence, and native execution authority are separate.

terms.name: refine
terms.effect: Increase representational resolution while retaining a declared coarse reading.
preconditions: No silent change of target, origin, normalization or observer
Every discarded region is justified or retained as an open alternative
preserves: Declared observations under a proved transport law
Original history in its own ledger

witness.description: Existing shrink and threshold distinctions; no new typed Goldberg refinement executed

terms.replay: No executable refine in this change. Construct and check p_k T_(k+1)=T_k p_k or a certified task-error bound before use.

terms.name: quotient
terms.effect: Form orbit data under a specified action while retaining fibres and stabilizers.
preconditions: Free action required before dividing ordinary Euler characteristic by group order
preserves: Raw histories outside the quotient view
does_not_imply: Free action from the name free

refusal: Nonfree action blocks the uncorrected Euler division rule

terms.name: lattice-polar
terms.effect: Separate rational polar/bipolar construction from paired-lattice admissibility.
input: frozen centrally symmetric full-dimensional rational vertex set
preconditions: The executable scope is exactly the four frozen fixtures in contract.json
Primal and dual coordinate changes are contragredient
preserves: Separate occurrence/history records in any future semantic bridge

witness.description: TO24 pairing 1/2 obstructs any compatible lattice; cube and sheared cube pass; scaled TO24 retains obstruction

refusal: NoCompatibleReflexiveLattice for a certified nonintegral vertex pairing
ReflexiveInDeclaredLattice only after integral primal and polar vertex checks
UnknownLattice otherwise; integer pairings alone are not promoted by this checker
residual: Trusted internally constructed evidence, not an untrusted-import API
No arbitrary shape or translated-origin search

terms.name: mirror
terms.effect: Request a specified comparison between two constructed Calabi-Yau geometries or theories.
preconditions: Specify whether Hodge matching, period comparison, or a stronger mirror statement is intended
Preserve lattice/regularity/resolution hypotheses for a toric construction
preserves: Only the structures named in the declared comparison
does_not_imply: Mirror from swapped Hodge numbers alone

witness.description: Reflexive lattice polytopes supply toric CY families with mirror Hodge relations under source hypotheses; none constructed in this run

refusal: Missing lattice or geometric hypotheses -> UnknownConstruction
Hodge matching without stronger comparison -> retain mirror residual
terms.replay: No executable mirror introduced. Replay the chosen source construction and each separately declared invariant check.
